authority_constraints: constructed cost runner has no Broker or workspace
formal execution remains fresh and unchanged
no durable cache or typed transport consumer
cost_policy: constructed_region cost must be measured by target CPython execution in a fresh authority-free bounded Guest; AST node count and operator count are descriptive only
measurement_order: deterministic shuffle by shuffle_seed, then five isolated repetitions per non-pilot case

mechanism_gate.failure_action: repair only the minimum analyzer-local classification defect and rerun the unchanged matrix; do not add execution authority
required: all positive non-pilot focus regions locally reusable
all negative controls focus regions not locally reusable
exact source spans and producer dependencies deterministic across repetitions
unknown calls heap mutation may_raise opaque control alias identity and non-JSON transport fail closed

opportunity_gate.consumer_decision: no derived-AST or typed-result consumer work from this synthetic matrix alone; natural-corpus and Phase 4 economics gates must also pass
opportunity_gate.required_cost_ordering: constructed median execution cost strictly increases from scalar_chain_16_before_effect through scalar_chain_64_after_effect to scalar_chain_128_between_effects
